authorization: User requested maximum 500 rounds, validation every round, patience 15, fresh five-seed comparison reruns, and concurrent tasks on RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB / RAM 32 GB.

training.initialization: fresh random initialization for every training seed; no legacy checkpoint loading
training.epoch_semantics: Existing model-specific semantics retained: full data pass for embedding models, one episode/update for InGram, 100 sampled minibatches for each ULTRA/TRIX round. Equal round caps do not imply equal compute.

proposed: PairProto-KGE computed on the corresponding new Mean-ComplEx checkpoint with original train-only prototype construction and fixed weights. No separate gradient training.
paircomp_role: Original PairComp retained as Uniform pair-moment composer, separate mechanism comparison, not an external published baseline.
scope: Main comparison partitions first. Other mechanism ablations, fixed configurations and replication partitions are outside this first rerun batch.
hyperparameter_policy: Carry forward development-selected learning rates and architecture, fixed before new test scoring. No new test-driven selection and no claim of a fresh learning-rate search under the larger budget.

extended_architectures.role: Additional baseline amendment frozen before new test scoring; existing results and dev choices are preserved.
extended_architectures.checkpoint_selection: typed-filtered dev MRR only; no test scoring until all model/source dev choices are locked

nodepiece.implementation: Official out-of-sample encoder and DistMult decoder; graph input and training loop adapted
nodepiece.anchor_strategy: degree on training message graph only

ingram.implementation: Official model and relation-graph construction; episodic train/message split

extended_architectures.graph_input: Training facts and composition edges of training formulas; inference adds only the known compositions of formulas in the current eval partition. No held-out target or inverse enters message graphs. Same original entity IDs, splits and frozen candidate ranges as existing methods.
extended_architectures.training_adaptations: No external pretraining for the main supervised comparison. Graph neural models use their native loss/architecture and recorded computational budgets, not claims of equal optimizer steps. Training target negatives exclude training truths only. Composition edges are message context, not extra target labels.
extended_architectures.evaluation: Exact existing candidate-range-filtered tail ranking with average tie ranks; MRR, Hits@1/3/5/10, MR; all methods evaluate identical query order.
extended_architectures.portability: If compiled rspmm is unavailable, call the official unfused message/aggregate/update with PyTorch scatter. Validate values and gradients on a tiny graph. Official source files stay unchanged.
extended_architectures.main_result_policy: Retain all successfully evaluated requested baselines regardless of whether they outperform PairProto-KGE. Document failures or budget exhaustion; never substitute custom token encoders under official method names.

scheduling.oom_policy: Retry only the failed unfinished run with lower concurrency and the same scientific configuration. Preserve attempt logs.

result_policy: Preserve every completed result regardless of rank. New output directory and new workbook; historical workbook, manuscript and experiments are not overwritten.
